92:14:3.noteEnglish: QAC gives تَلَظَّىٰ no form tag (Form I); it is Form V تَلَظَّى (tafaʿʿala, ta prefix + doubled middle radical) with one of the two ta's elided from تَتَلَظَّى. Its mood is correctly indicative (hidden damma on the alif; nothing governs it), the sentence being an adjective of نَارًا.

rejected.reason: Defective verb after negative لَا (not lam of command): indicative with hidden damma on the alif; adjective clause of نَارًا.
يُؤْتِى is indicative with hidden damma on the ya; no governing particle (sila of ٱلَّذِى).
يَتَزَكَّىٰ is indicative with hidden damma on the alif; ungoverned hal clause.
Passive تُجْزَىٰٓ is indicative with hidden damma on the alif; ungoverned adjective clause of نِعْمَةٍ.
After لَسَوْفَ the verb is indicative; final alif maqsura retained (hidden damma).
After لَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ is indicative; ya retained with hidden damma.
Joined by fa to indicative يُعْطِيكَ; alif retained, hidden damma: indicative.
Emphatic lam (in khabar of إِنَّ) does not govern; alif retained, indicative.
Sila of ٱلَّذِى, ungoverned; alif retained with hidden damma: indicative.
Khabar of أَنَّ, ungoverned; alif retained: indicative. لَمْ governs only يَعْلَم.
No five-verbs nun is dropped: the tanwin-alif is the light nun of emphasis (نَسْفَعَنْ), the verb is mabni on fatha, not subjunctive or jussive; QAC's mood tag is a non-issue.
Correct: after lam of command يَدْعُ is jussive, its final waw dropped.
Singular يَتْلُو with orthographic alif after the root waw (not a plural waw); indicative with hidden damma; adjective clause of رَسُولٌ.
تَجْرِى is indicative with hidden damma on the ya; ungoverned hal clause.
Correct: jussive answer of the conditional مَن يَعْمَلْ; the final alif of يَرَى is dropped for jazm.
Correct: jussive answer of the conditional مَن يَعْمَلْ; the final alif of يَرَى is dropped for jazm.
Hollow verb زَارَ: the 2MP perfect active is زُرْتُمْ (damma for the waw-medial root); the i'rab gives a fa'il, and ٱلْمَقَابِرَ is its object, so active is correct.
